$comment: What sbom/generate.mjs cannot read from a lockfile. Edit this file, then run node sbom/generate.mjs.
licenseOverrides: packages whose metadata gives no SPDX licence, or that no install has; keyed by ecosystem:name@version, where * stands for any part of a name.
podLicenses: pods whose podspec is in neither the repository nor node_modules (CocoaPods trunk, or generated at pod install).
soldeer: the licence and use of each Soldeer dependency; versions come from contracts/soldeer.lock.
parts: per part, what no lockfile records: vendored files, native libraries fetched at build time, container images.
evidence: a file that must contain the given text while the component is as listed; the generator fails when it does not.
Evidence under node_modules/ is checked only when that file is installed.
tools: development tools that are not in the repository and not distributed with any part.
licenseNotes: what a licence outside the permissive set asks, shown next to the components that carry it.

npm:esprima@1.2.2.reason: package.json names only "BSD"; the licence header of esprima.js is the 2-clause text.

npm:prelude-ls@1.1.2.reason: package.json uses the deprecated "licenses" array with the single type MIT.

npm:oboe@2.1.5.reason: package.json names only "BSD"; its LICENCE file is the 2-clause (FreeBSD) text.

npm:@tradle/react-native-http@2.0.1.reason: package.json says "MIT/X11"; its LICENSE and LICENSE_HTTP_BROWSERIFY files are the MIT text.

cocoapods:ReactNativeDependencies@*.license: MIT AND BSL-1.0 AND Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND (Apache-2.0 OR BSL-1.0 OR MIT)
cocoapods:ReactNativeDependencies@*.reason: The podspec gives React Native's MIT, but the pod is React Native's prebuild of boost, double-conversion, fast_float, fmt, folly, glog and SocketRocket, each listed under its own licence.

npm:@esbuild/*@0.17.19.reason: esbuild 0.17.19's builds for each platform, under esbuild's MIT; an install has only its own platform's.

npm:lightningcss-*@1.33.0.reason: lightningcss 1.33.0's builds for each platform, under lightningcss's MPL-2.0; an install has only its own platform's.

licenseNotes.EUPL-1.2: Copyleft: whoever distributes the component, changed or not, makes its source available under the EUPL 1.2.
licenseNotes.LGPL-3.0-only: Weak copyleft: whoever distributes the component makes its source, with any changes, available under the LGPL 3.0, and lets users replace it in the work that uses it.
licenseNotes.LicenseRef-RSALv2 OR SSPL-1.0: Source-available: may be used and self-hosted, but not offered to others as a managed Redis service.
licenseNotes.MPL-2.0: File-level copyleft: whoever distributes the component makes its files' source, with any changes to them, available under the MPL 2.0.
licenseNotes.OFL-1.1: May be bundled with software; the licence text goes with the font, and the font may not be sold on its own.
